name: @mivlet/hosted-runner
description: Mivlet hosted text tasks, phone relay, and deployment-gated isolated computers.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tasks.json && tsc -p tsconfig.phone.json && tsc -p tsconfig.coding.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tasks.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.phone.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.coding.json --noEmit
scripts.tasks:types: wrangler types --config wrangler.tasks.jsonc --include-runtime false --env-interface HostedTaskBindings tasks-configuration.d.ts
scripts.phone:types: wrangler types --config wrangler.phone.jsonc --include-runtime false --env-interface PhoneRelayBindings phone-configuration.d.ts
scripts.coding:types: wrangler types --config wrangler.coding.jsonc --include-runtime false --env-interface HostedCodingBindings coding-configuration.d.ts
